findings.title: Findings converge on the uncapped, single-job DEBUG drain
findings.why_it_matters: Five findings land on one mechanism: the budget-exempt DEBUG tier deletes until drained inside one job on the single write queue.
findings.recommended: A: Re-evaluate the uncapped, single-job DEBUG drain before addressing Findings 2-6 individually.
findings.chosen: A: Re-evaluate the uncapped, single-job DEBUG drain before addressing Findings 2-6 individually.
findings.choice_reason: Wanted as little machinery as possible; re-evaluation settled on no exemption (shared budget), recorded as D3 superseding parent D9's exemption.

findings.title: The uncapped drain holds the single writer long enough to withdraw awaited writes and drop log batches at every level
findings.why_it_matters: Awaited writes withdrawn after 60 s and log batches of every level dropped during a large one-time drain.
findings.recommended: A: Give the DEBUG tier its own per-run bound

findings.title: The startup catch-up runs the uncapped tier inside a shared timeout, starving retention and skipping the shrink
findings.why_it_matters: A large DEBUG backlog consumes the 15 s startup budget, so age retention never runs at startup.

findings.title: The termination guarantee is inferred from queue structure, with no backstop
findings.why_it_matters: A future writer bypassing the queue would make the loop an unbounded writer hold.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: The uncapped job ignores shutdown
findings.why_it_matters: Shutdown during a long drain waits out the drain timeout and may close queued writes unwritten.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: The summary that explains wiped DEBUG history can be dropped by the queue the drain filled
findings.why_it_matters: The persisted failsafe summary may be dropped after a long drain.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation

findings.title: On an install sitting at the limit, persisted DEBUG lines survive about one failsafe interval, and the docs don't say so
findings.why_it_matters: Users can't tell their deliberate capture had no room.
findings.recommended: A: Docs sentence: DEBUG capture is best-effort against max_size_mb
findings.chosen: A: Docs sentence: DEBUG capture is best-effort against max_size_mb

findings.title: D1's comparison overstates the partitioning option's cost, so the ratified overlap rests on an inaccurate row
findings.why_it_matters: The ratification compared against a costlier partition option than the real one.
findings.recommended: A: Keep overlapping targets, correct D1's B column
findings.chosen: A: Keep overlapping targets, correct D1's B column

findings.title: The DEBUG target's failsafe priority is unspecified
findings.why_it_matters: A tie with framework executions at priority 1 would group the tiers.
findings.chosen: State priority=0 for the DEBUG target in the Summary

findings.title: The partial index's write cost on DEBUG inserts is asserted, not measured
findings.why_it_matters: D2 quantified one side of the trade only.
findings.recommended: A: Keep the partial index, record the measured insert overhead in D2
findings.chosen: A: Keep the partial index, record the measured insert overhead in D2

findings.title: The partial index silently stops being used if the level filter is a bound parameter
